wps.title: WP 3.7: io/Profile and the verb profile, with the folded-signature form and its privacy case
wps.brief: WP 3.7 of V3_MILESTONES.md (§9): io/Profile and the verb profile, narrowed to looking, as the Facsimile's shape does. Read §9's row 3.7, §17 item 24 and its 2026-10-19 decision line (signatures may be read from an environment classified real; the allowlist gains one form for them; a privacy case), the Facsimile's shape and its P6 under archive/v2/ssdt-agent/facsimile/ (README.md, TARGET.md, cases/), archive/v2/TWIN_SUCCESSION.md Appendix D, V3_ARCHITECTURE.md §8.2 where it still holds, and io/SqlServer.Allowlist.cs with its tests. dbchange profile --env <e> <schema.table.column> returns the value-free shape of one column an authored script reads: signatures (TRANSLATE of each value to character classes) with their counts, signatures seen fewer than five times folded into one count, and distinct-as-collated beside distinct-binary. The allowlist gains exactly one form for it, the signature with its count and the rare ones folded, refused in every other shape; its negative cases include a signature query without the fold, one that returns a value or a substring of one, a TRANSLATE whose class map is not the committed one, and a column read without TRANSLATE. Decide, with a decision line, what a signature does with characters outside the classes (punctuation, other scripts), since a signature that keeps them can carry a short value; the privacy case must hold either way. --vocabulary is exit 9 until the environment is confirmed synthetic. profile --env <e> --counts measures row tiers only, into dbchange/ledgers/row-tiers.md, with the environment and the date on every row; --commit is always asked and is tested only against a local bare repository. Done when: law 12′ is green in its planted form (a test with its Law trait); the privacy case shows that no value is reconstructable from what the form returns (a fixture column holding PlantedValue's values and values unique enough to identify a row: no output holds a value, and every signature with a count under five is folded); M3's exit 4, the planted-value scan's second half, is a test with [Trait("Exit", "M3.4")]: profile against a fixture environment classified real stores no value, and a declared witness carrying a literal that is neither synthetic nor defined by the repository is refused (WP 3.5's declared witnesses hold the refusal; pin it there if it is not yet pinned).
